claims.claim: Elon Musk, Tesla'nın gelecek yıl Cybercab'e yer açmak için Cybertruck üretimini azaltacağını açıkladı.

evidence.quote: Elon Musk’s declaration Friday that Tesla would be “winding down” production of the Cybertruck next year to make room for the Cybercab was fascinating for a number of reasons.

Tesla will wind down production of its Cybertruck vehicles at its Texas factory next year, Elon Musk says. He did not spell out whether it plans to stop making them entirely or shift production elsewhere, but did say the decision was to "make room" for building more of its self-driving Cybercab cars.

claims.claim: Elon Musk, 2019 yılındaki bir kazanç çağrısında Tesla Cybertruck'ın şimdiye kadarki en iyi ürünleri olduğunu belirtti.

evidence.quote: “I think the Tesla Cybertruck is our best product ever,” he declared during a 2019 earnings call.

claims.claim: Tesla, Cybertruck için yıllık 250.000 adetlik üretim ve talep hedeflemişti.

evidence.quote: Tesla actually thought the Cybertruck would be a huge hit, targeting production and demand of 250,000 units per year.
Musk had predicted annual sales of 250,000 after commercial production of Cybertruck began in 2023.

claims.claim: Tesla bugüne kadar toplamda 70.000 adet Cybertruck satışı gerçekleştirdi.

evidence.quote: To date, the company has only sold 70,000 units — total.

claims.claim: Elon Musk, Cumhuriyetçi adayların seçim kampanyalarına 445 milyon dolardan fazla bağış yaptı.

evidence.quote: Musk poured over $445 million into Republican races

claims.claim: Elon Musk, Teksas'taki seçim çalışmaları için 200 milyon dolardan fazla harcama yaptı.

evidence.quote: Musk dropped more than $200 million on the Lone Star State alone.

Between funnels of $168 million to super PACs backing Republican Senate candidate Ken Paxton and nearly $35 million redirected from his own America PAC, Musk dropped more than $200 million on the Lone Star State alone.

claims.claim: Cybertruck, 2024 yılının başlarında en çok satan premium elektrikli kamyonetlerden biri oldu.

evidence.quote: While it succeeded as a viral PR spectacle and initially became a top-selling premium electric pickup in early 2024, it ultimately collapsed under the weight of Musk’s own hubris.
